name: Cheng Brain Tumor MRI Detection
description: T1-weighted contrast-enhanced brain MRI slices from patients with brain tumors, released by Southern Medical University, China. Acquired 2005–2010 at Nanfang Hospital, Guangzhou, and Tianjin Medical University General Hospital, with tumor borders traced by radiologists. Boxes are derived from the authors' tumor masks, and splits are grouped by patient. Source: Cheng et al., "Enhanced Performance of Brain Tumor Classification via Tumor Region Augmentation and Partition," PLoS ONE 2015; figshare.com/articles/dataset/brain_tumor_dataset/1512427.
